name: Personal: Support Triage (Indie / Small Shop)
description: Solo-operator starter: classify incoming support emails by urgency and topic, draft replies for the routine ones, and escalate anything urgent to your phone/Slack immediately. Replies send only after your approval. Built for Personal Edition (BYOK or fully local).
author: Atom

inputs.name: urgent_keywords
inputs.label: Urgent keywords
inputs.description: Comma-separated keywords that mark a message urgent for your product.
inputs.default_value: down, outage, billing error, refund, data loss

inputs.name: business_hours
inputs.label: Business hours
inputs.description: When instant escalation is allowed to buzz you outside quiet hours.

steps.name: Watch support inbox
steps.description: Trigger on new email in the support label/address.

steps.name: Classify urgency + topic
steps.description: Agent classifies each message: urgent vs routine, and topic (bug, billing, how-to, feature).

steps.name: Escalate urgent instantly
steps.description: Urgent messages ping you on Slack right away with sender, subject, and a suggested first response.

steps.name: Draft replies for routine mail
steps.description: Draft concise, accurate replies for routine messages using product docs as context.

steps.name: Approve before send (HITL)
steps.description: Review drafted replies in one batch — approve, edit, or discard. Nothing is sent unreviewed.

steps.name: Send approved replies
steps.description: Send approved replies and label the thread handled.
